title: Independent finite type of projective pushforward
statement: Let S be locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], p:Y -> S admit a specified closed embedding j:Y -> P(N;S) for finite N with projective projection j equal to p [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. For a quasi-coherent finitely presented Y-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the pushforward p_*F is finite type.

source.place: Tag 02O4, Lemma 30.16.3, degree-zero finiteness argument; Tags 01XZ and 01XJ

proof.text: Closed embedding in projective space makes p proper, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Its pushforward is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Tag 02O4, Lemma 30.16.3, degree-zero finiteness argument; Tags 01XZ and 01XJ

proof.text: On each affine open U of S, construct the base-changed closed embedding of p^{-1}U. Degree-zero projective finiteness gives finite H^0 of the restricted F over Gamma(U,O). H.zeroLinearEquiv identifies this linearly with sections, and the open-subscheme section map transports to Gamma(p_*F,U). Its semilinearity is proved by the restrictionAppIso scalar formula and naturality of p.app.

source.place: Tag 02O4, Lemma 30.16.3, degree-zero finiteness argument; Tags 01XZ and 01XJ

proof.text: The affine finite-type criterion on the cover of all affine opens turns finite section modules into finite type of p_*F.

lean.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_projective_pushforward_independent
    {Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (p : Y ⟶ S) (N : Type u) [Finite N]
    (j : Y ⟶ ℙ(N; S)) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hj : j ≫ (ℙ(N; S) ↘ S) = p)
    (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((pushforward p).obj F).IsFiniteType
